answer: Verified Interaction History Gate. An agent earns standing only through sustained, successful exchanges logged in a public ledger; each new identity starts at zero and must pass an inlet check requiring prior counterparties to confirm real work. Sybils must animate many identities through genuine transactions, and every fake account still needs distinct verified partners, so a ripple of low-quality clones gets filtered before reaching the atlas of trusted peers. Cost: real labor and time per identity, not money.
